title: Tower Maze Defense (v9)
description: Build towers along a procedurally generated maze path to stop waves of enemies — now with a Mint tower that earns money per wave and bosses with 30x health.
prompt: change the default target from nearest to first. Make the bosses harder instead of 10x health make it 30x. Add a new tower a money maker, it costs 500 but gives 50 per wave on level 1, each upgrade increments it by 50 and costs 5x for each upgrade.
